review: Request: at round 19 Moss (health 100, satiety 90.9, energy 39, standing on ordinary forest floor) asked for a learnable practical method to fashion an owned branch into a simple digging tool with measurable condition and usefulness established only through use, owning item-9-moss-89, 1.6 units of fallen branch from canopy-69 (not the 1.8 of the request), after probe presses at load 0.25 (held) and 0.5 (did not hold). World Agent decision: develop (learning 4) one general operation shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool with modes inspect, shape, trial/use, maintain, pause, resume and cancel, by controlled abrasion of an existing wooden end against a usable rough abrasive surface (no cutting edge, fire, water or binding), with conserved wood and abrasive debris, release only when the measured end meets a declared criterion, use strokes that move at most 0.001 m3 of loose surface soil into a local deposit resolved from end geometry, soil resistance and load, usefulness only after an actual nonzero displacement, no gathering multiplier and no excavation of hard ground. Equivalence check: no registered contract shapes wood or moves soil with a tool; the planting packages (root-planting-trial, small-soil-patch-preparation, cultivate-plant, cultivation-trial, cultivate-plants, plant-cultivation, plant-establishment-trial) dig or clear by hand only as a planting step in other scopes, cutting-edge-assessment@1 has no shaping law, draw-from-observation@1 makes finger grooves only, and probe, consult and exchange establish neither manufacture nor displacement, so a new package was needed. Reuse (implementation only; no existing package file was edited): the open-hardness-physics scratchStroke contact rule, its pressure predicate and 0.0001 kg dust quantum (re-applied, not called); the ex21 small-combustion-source@1 declared rod (smallFireRod: green wood 900 kg/m3, 25 diameters, so one whole branch unit is a 0.0396 m by 0.991 m rod, close to the branch-screen@1 1.1 m rod), its 0.015-0.05 m grip, flexibility at most 3 and 0.3 m length bounds, its 21.6 kJ of hand work per energy and its granular and plastic materials (SMALL_FIRE, SMALL_FIRE_COVERS); the foundation-open@1 open.probe press rule (a material holds a load not above hardness / 10, so the branch holds 0.3, matching Moss's 0.25 and 0.5 results) and openRemember; the ex19 shared piece, contact and firm-ground checks (ex19MaterialPiece, ex19MaterialContact, ex19MaterialGround); openConditions for ground type, moisture and waterlogging; the ex22 yielding-ground classes (forest floor and meadow yield; rocky ground, wet bank and waterlogged soil do not); the ex23 root-zone depth of 0.15 m; and the ex23 crack-and-separate-casing@1 work lifecycle, pinned gear, wear record and ledger pattern with the collective-work escrow helpers. The scratch hash file received the sha256 of crack-and-separate-casing@1 before this change, and the new test asserts one digest over all 116 previously registered packages and the individual hashes of foundation-open@1, shell-compression-opening@1, cutting-edge-assessment@1, small-combustion-source@1, draw-from-observation@1, rooted-plant-watering@1 and crack-and-separate-casing@1; the only shared runtime change is the registration line, so no revision gate was needed. Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool@1 (ability and handler long.shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool, equivalence material:wood-end-abrasion-soil-displacement:1, learning 4 with no study energy, 3,156 code units, appended last to the package list, no visual component, no satisfaction source). inspect (1 round, 0.5 energy) reports by hand and eye an own wooden item's pieces (whole rods and the shorter rest piece), diameter, flat ends, visible soundness and achievable end (taper 0.119 m, tip at most 0.0139 m, 0.3 m shaft, smallest piece 0.5 unit), or a tool's end and condition, and a reachable soil patch's ground, moisture, waterlogging, whether it yields and what was dug, never hidden resistance or strength values. shape (target an own unreserved rigid wooden item, quantity in exact tenths, one piece of at most one unit; abrasive a solid, rigid, inedible, noncombustible surface in reach, which is its own support, or an own whole such piece resting on firm ground where the person stands) quotes free with quoteOnly true (Moss's whole unit: 0.0673 kg to remove, at most 0.01 kg per stroke, 7 strokes, 2 segments, 7 energy, abrasive wear at most 0.01 kg per stroke), reserves the piece in one work and pins the abrasive; each stroke is 1 round and 1 energy, at most 4 per segment, after which the work pauses until resume. A stroke is 100 abrasive passes; the scratch rule is applied both ways, so a surface no harder than the other sheds one 0.0001 kg quantum per pass: up to 0.01 kg of wood leaves the end (never below a 0.2 diameter tip) as an unowned wood-shaping-debris item at the worksite carrying source piece, material and work, and the end region of 3 diameters tapers by the exact frustum volume removed; an abrasive no harder than the wood loses the same mass from its solids into an abrasive-grit-debris item (an outcrop's mass is not represented, so its wear is recorded in the ledger only), and a stone or flint face, harder by more than the 0.5 margin, is not worn. A surface that removes nothing is a paid stroke that ends the work and returns the piece. The piece is released, still use-unverified, when the measured tip is at most 0.35 diameter with at least 0.3 m of shaft behind the taper; piece plus dust equals the input mass exactly. use (target an own shaped tool, x, y a point within reach snapped to a 0.125 m radius patch clear of objects and plants, load 0.05-1, default 0.25, 1 round, 1 energy) presses and levers the end 30 times at load x 500 N: the tip sinks until the soil resistance across its cross-section bears the push (forest floor 0.3 MPa, meadow 0.8 MPa at moisture 0.65, times (0.65 / moisture)^1.5 within 0.5-8), each lever breaks out a cone of soil as deep and as wide as that penetration, and at most 1000 cm3 of the patch's loose top 0.15 m (7363 cm3) moves per stroke into a heap record 0.25 m toward the worker, with hole volume always equal to heap volume; rocky ground, a wet bank, waterlogged soil and open or shallow water are paid strokes that move nothing, and below the loose layer nothing is dug. Every ground contact wears one 0.0001 kg quantum off the tip by the scratch rule (mineral grit or rock harder than wood), recorded with the patch, which shortens and widens the tip along its taper. A load above the wood strength (0.3 for branch) splits the end; a split end holds half and above that its taper breaks off as a conserved fragment item at the patch, leaving a flat end that must be maintained. maintain uses the same strokes and segments on an own shaped or broken tool whose end no longer meets the criterion and re-points it with real material loss; it cannot heal a split, and a sound or split end that meets the criterion has nothing to maintain. pause, resume and cancel cost nothing; rechecks of piece, abrasive, reach and energy refuse an explicit start or resume at no cost and pause continuing work before any charge, as does a round without a stroke; cancel returns the piece once as it now is with its record, which a later shape continues from; death leaves the piece at the worksite and ends the work; nothing runs by itself. Events digging-tool-quoted, -inspected, -started, -abraded, -no-removal, -abrasive-wear, -released, -maintained, -ended, -stroke, -displaced, -no-displacement, -use-verified, -cracked, -broke, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed carry view metadata (operation, mode, phase, actor, target, work and source, material, progress, end geometry, visible condition from unfinished blank through shaped, use unverified and use-verified tool to broken end, debris mass, displaced volume, position, result reason, badge null); only an actual displacement shows displaced earth and only the completed geometry check shows a finished end. Personal records are deduplicated by material, abrasive, ground, load band and outcome; their information events carry this interface, which no satisfaction source listens to, and the release event never carries a qualified flag, so there is no practice milestone, satisfaction or reward (the review's proposed bounded benefit was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards). Owner rules: only the owner can control the work or use the tool; a given tool, a whole unit, serves its new owner with its record. Assumptions: (1) one whole branch unit is one straight ex21 rod and a selected piece is a contiguous part of one rod, so a piece is at most one unit; (2) a stroke round is 100 controlled passes of one scratch contact each (about 1.9 J of hand work per mm3 of green wood); (3) roughness is not represented, so any rigid noncombustible inedible solid face abrades by the hardness rule, combustible faces are excluded as friction heating and sand and clay as granular or plastic; (4) the scratch rule applies in both sliding directions; (5) the probe load scale is a hand push of 500 N at load 1 and the press rule applies to the whole tool, half for a split end; (6) soil resistance values, the moisture exponent, 30 levers per stroke, the 45 degree soil cone, the 0.25 m patch grid, the 0.15 m loose layer and the heap position are declared values; (7) tip wear of one quantum per ground contact and the small-step frustum update of the worn tip; (8) the dug hole and heap are a world state record, not an object, and do not change terrain, moisture, plants or any other rule; (9) the abrasive is pinned and rechecked rather than reserved; (10) the reserved piece's own id is not resubmittable, so paused work continues by resume. Moss can now study for 4 rounds, inspect item-9-moss-89 (one whole 0.991 m rod and a 0.594 m piece, 0.0396 m thick, sound), walk to the start-2-stone outcrop about 4.9 m away, quote and shape a 1-unit piece in 7 strokes over two segments for 7 energy into a 1.03 kg tool with a 0.0124 m tip and 0.07 kg of dust left by the rock (0.6 unit of stock kept), then at load 0.25 on forest floor penetrate about 0.047 m and move 0.001 m3 per stroke for about six strokes per patch, which verifies the tool; meadow turf yields only 0.000013 m3 at 0.25 and 0.000076 m3 at 0.3, and about nine strokes later the tip needs maintenance. A throwaway check on the archived round-19 world installed the package and did exactly that (study, inspection, 13 navigation rounds, quote, 4 shape and 3 resume strokes costing exactly 7 energy, release, the walk back and one 0.25 stroke at patch 14.5, 18 moving 0.001 m3), left the wellbeing source unrefreshed and was deleted. Narrowed: the crack-and-separate-casing test's assertions that its package is last and that ex23 has exactly two packages now check that it is the second ex23 package and that the first two are as before, and its byte-identity check covers the packages registered before it. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the changed files, and 19 test files with 192 tests (this test, the two long-run scenario tests and every test of experiments 19 to 23) passed.
